title: Maya Puthagum
desc: Guru, an assistant director, dreams of a dragon, which leads him to a mysterious book and its owner. The latter instructs him to meet a producer at a palace to film the manuscript's contents.

title: Barood
desc: Jai, an honest police officer, falls in love with Neha, Mr Singhal's daughter. However, he suspects Mr Singhal to be a criminal and tries to catch him red-handed.

title: Real Tevar
desc: Harsha is the idealistic scion of a self-made multimillionaire, Ravikanth. After a chance meeting with Charuseela leads him to a remote village, Harsha wishes to develop it with her help.

title: Dabangg 3
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a corrupt police officer, leads a happy life with his wife and family. However, when his past enemy returns to wreak havoc, he must protect his loved ones from harm.

title: Qatil Saya
desc: A police officer investigates the mystery behind unnatural deaths after taking charge of his new post at a hill station.
